key_concepts: The 5Rs of waste management are reduce, reuse, recycle, recover, and repair.
Reduce means using less of something to create smaller amounts of waste.
Reuse means using items over and over again instead of throwing them away.
Recycle means making waste materials into new products.
Repair means fixing damaged items such as old computers and appliances.
